description: This file defines the EditorManager class and React hooks for managing editor state, configuration, and toolbar in the Notesnook project.

classes.name: EditorManager
classes.description: Manages editor instances, configurations, and toolbar settings within the Notesnook application.

methods.name: getEditor
methods.description: Retrieves the editor context for a given ID.

methods.name: setEditor
methods.description: Sets or removes an editor context for a given ID.

methods.name: updateEditor
methods.description: Updates the editor context for a given ID with partial data or via a function.
